purpose: Immediate detection of divergence among intended local package, evidence, and (optional) live host. Minimize false positives: FAIL only on hard identity mismatches; WARN for expected pre-cutover / age soft signals.
falsePositiveControls: Do not FAIL solely because live host lacks packageIdentity when package-prepared.liveCutoverExecuted=false (expected pre-cutover)
Do not FAIL solely on absolute artifact age unless -StrictAge
Do not FAIL when ledger FAIL@76.7 aligns with manifest FAIL (honest debt)
DLL SHA Windows-publish vs Linux-container may differ - compare corpus+stamp+version first; DLL mismatch alone is WARN unless versions also diverge
Skip live probes by default (-ProbeLive to enable)

failWhen: stamp packageVersion mismatch repo vs publish
prepared dllSha256 != publish dll when prepared present
warnWhen: prepared buildTimestamp older than publish stamp after re-stamp
source corpus missing but publish present

failWhen: repo vs publish evalStatus or pass rate diverge
manifest claims PASS while ledger authority is FAIL
warnWhen: manifest report path leaf differs from ledger authority report leaf but both FAIL same rate

failWhen: JSON entry ids missing from JSONL
warnWhen: ledger updatedAt older than newest suite report on disk by > maxLedgerLagHours (soft)
live packageVersion behind publish when ProbeLive and identity present

failWhen: prepared claims liveCutoverExecuted=true but host identity missing/mismatched (ProbeLive)
